FIREBALL RELEASE — arms thrust forward at apex of cast, massive flaming orb hurtling away trailing comet-tail of ember-sparks, shockwave radiating outward kicking up flagstone-dust and rippling banners, fleeing villagers parting in foreground silhouettes while siege engines launch counter-fire from the burning watchtower behind her.

RANGER MID-LOOSE — bow drawn to cheek, enchanted arrow already streaking away in motion-blur trailing green light, her cloak whipping sideways from the wind of its passage, background showing allied cavalry charging past through smoke while dragon shadow sweeps across the battlefield overhead.

PALADIN DIVINE STRIKE — warhammer overhead mid-swing, column of golden light erupting from the weapon's head boring skyward, cracking flagstones radiating from her planted boots, shockwave expanding outward as corrupted spirits recoil and scatter, collapsing temple archway crumbling behind her.

NECROMANCER RAISING DEAD — both arms thrust downward, skeletal hands and arms erupting from cracked earth around her feet, purple-black energy tendrils spiraling from her fingertips into the ground, gravestones toppling as the dead rise while distant torchlight procession of hunters approaches through the cemetery mist.

MONK CHI-STRIKE — mid-air spinning kick, leg extended with blazing golden trail arcing behind it, her body twisted impossibly horizontal, shockwave rippling the air, wooden training posts exploding into splinters in the background while master watches from temple steps and cherry blossoms scatter in the magical wind.

DRUID SHAPE-SHIFT — caught mid-transformation, right arm already massive bear paw with fur bursting through cracking skin, face half-human half-beast with glowing green eyes, earth erupting around her feet as roots break through stone, panicking bandits fleeing while forest behind her surges forward with animated vines.

CROSSBOW SNAP-SHOT — crouched behind overturned market cart, bolt already blurring across frame toward unseen target, splinters exploding from cart edge where enemy arrow just struck, background showing crowded bazaar scattering in panic while building above begins collapsing, dust and debris raining down.

LIGHTNING-STORM SUMMONER — both arms raised to roiling thunderhead, massive forking bolt arcing down striking the ground between her outstretched hands, arcane circle blazing beneath her feet, her hair lifting straight up in static charge, enemy war-machines exploding in chain-reaction across the distant siege line.

MOUNTED DRAGON-RIDER MID-DIVE — gripping saddle-horn as dragon banks hard past crumbling tower, her cloak streaming horizontal, dragon's wings blocking half the sky, tower stones tumbling past in motion-blur, distant city burning below while enemy wyvern-riders scatter from the dragon's approach trailing flame.

ROGUE ROOFTOP PURSUIT — sprinting full-tilt across clay tiles, tiles shattering and sliding behind her boots, body leaned forward for speed, pursuing guards visible three rooftops back firing crossbows, arrows streaking past, marketplace chaos below with overturned stalls and scattering crowds, distant palace alarm bells ringing.

ICE NOVA DETONATION — arms swept downward in completion gesture, expanding ring of crystalline frost exploding outward from her position shattering flagstones, ice-spikes erupting in radial pattern, enemy soldiers caught mid-charge freezing in motion-blur, background showing allied mages also casting from battlements while catapult stones arc overhead.

WARRIOR BLADE-PARRY — sword raised vertical deflecting massive strike from off-frame, shower of orange sparks erupting from blade-contact, her boots skidding backward carving furrows in dirt, face grimacing with effort, background showing fortress gate splintering inward while defenders rush to reinforce and burning oil pours from murder-holes.

CLERIC HEALING WAVE — kneeling with arms outstretched, golden dome expanding outward in visible ripple, motes of light raining down like fireflies, wounded allies in background visibly recovering as wave passes through them, battlefield smoke parting around the expanding radiance while distant explosions silhouette the carnage.

ELDRITCH BLAST CHANNEL — right arm extended forward, crackling violet beam boring from her open palm toward distant target, left hand bracing her wrist, beam's passage ionizing the air creating purple after-trail, her hair and cloak whipping in arcane wind, ritual circle beneath her feet pulsing, tower wall behind exploding from enemy counter-spell.

BARBARIAN CHARGE — greataxe raised overhead in both hands, mouth open in war-cry, body in full sprint with motion-blur on her pumping legs, enemy line visible ahead breaking formation and scattering, dust cloud kicked up behind her boots, allied warriors charging in formation behind while arrows volley overhead toward enemy position.

RANGER WALL-VAULT BACKSHOT — mid-leap off fortress wall, body inverted and twisted, bow drawn and loosing arrow back toward pursuing guards on rampart, arrow streaking away in motion-blur, her cloak billowing upward, background showing courtyard far below with market in chaos and mounted reinforcements arriving through gates.

SHAMAN STORM-CALL — arms raised to churning black sky, multiple lightning bolts forking down around her position, wind whipping her ritual garments and scattering totems, ground glyphs flaring brilliant blue, ocean waves behind her rising in impossible peaks responding to her summons while enemy fleet burns in the harbor.

ASSASSIN DESCENDING STRIKE — mid-leap from tavern rafter, dagger reversed in right hand, body compact and diving, target guard visible below just beginning to look up, lantern-light catching blade edge, background patrons scattering and overturning tables, barkeep ducking behind counter, door bursting open with reinforcements entering.

FIRE-CHAIN WHIP — right arm extended in casting completion, multiple tendrils of flame spiraling outward from her fingertips in whip-cracks, each tendril leaving ember-trails and scorch-marks, stone floor cracking from heat, enemy constructs in background shattering as flame-whips connect, ancient library burning while scrolls whip past in magical wind.

KNIGHT SHIELD-CHARGE — tower shield forward, body low behind it, lightning-strikes glinting off polished steel face, boots churning mud in full sprint, shockwave radiating from her armored bulk, enemy spearwall ahead bracing for impact, battlefield chaos behind showing cavalry engaging and siege tower approaching walls.

THROWING-AXE RELEASE — mid-spin follow-through, axe blurring away from her extended hand catching firelight, her braid whipping around from rotation momentum, background showing burning warehouse with pursuing gang members diving for cover, dock crates exploding as axe passes through toward ship's mooring rope target.

PORTAL SUMMONING APEX — both hands tracing final complex glyph, reality cracking open behind her in jagged tear showing otherworld beyond, tentacles and claws partially emerged, air rippling in waves, her hair lifting in impossible wind, ritual components scattering, distant city walls visible with defenders watching in horror.

MOUNTED GALLOP ESCAPE — leaning low past camera on racing warhorse, banner streaming from her lance horizontal with speed, horse's hooves kicking up massive dust cloud, motion-blur on landscape, pursuing riders visible behind losing ground, canyon walls narrowing ahead while rockslide begins cascading from heights above.

DRAGON-SHOULDER FIRE-BLAST — standing at massive dragon's shoulder as it unleashes roaring gout of flame from open maw, heat-shimmer distorting the air, her arm raised shielding face from radiance, dragon's scales reflecting orange firelight, distant enemy fortress tower melting under sustained blast while defenders scatter.

ROPE-BRIDGE COLLAPSE SPRINT — full sprint across swaying bridge, planks already breaking and falling behind her boots, ropes snapping with visible fraying, chasm yawning far below with river visible, opposite cliff-edge twenty feet ahead, background showing jungle canopy and ancient temple ruins with pursuing cultists reaching bridge-start loosing arrows that streak past.
